title: ORGANIC CHEMISTRY
description: Covers aliphatic and aromatic chemistry. Introduces nomenclature, mechanism and synthesis of alkanes, cycloalkanes, alkenes, alkyl halides, and alkynes.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: CH 123, 223Z, 223HZ, 233, 233H or 203.
A minimum grade of C- is required in CH 123, CH 223Z, CH 223HZ, CH 233, CH 233H and CH 203.
